Gaussian splatting · Attempt 01

5 TRAINING RUNS COMPLETE / RTX 4090

Each native-resolution COLMAP dataset was trained independently with gsplat 1.5.3 for 30,000 steps. The separate 8× component is also retained as its own model.

Quality review required. A sampled 2× validation view has severe washed-out and occluded areas. Completed training does not establish a faithful room reconstruction. All four COLMAP pipelines are complete, including full-resolution fusion and meshing.

Settings and local outputs

CUDA device 0 · default strategy · packed rasterization · data factor 1 · 7,000/30,000-step evaluations and checkpoints · separate 100-step smoke test passed.

Files remain in gsplat_local/runs/<dataset>/: ckpts/ckpt_29999_rank0.pt, ply/point_cloud_29999.ply, and renders/val_step29999_*.png. The saved validation images show source and predicted views side by side. These files are local; this section reports aggregate results only.

SetFolderDimensionsPixels / imageStorage

Every folder contains frame_0001.png through frame_0500.png. Reductions use Lanczos directly from the full-resolution masters. A 2× reduction halves both dimensions.

HOW TO READ THESE RESULTS

Coverage matters as much as detail.

Each resolution is reconstructed independently. Models have arbitrary scale and coordinate systems; they are not aligned. Dense processing uses the largest registered component. Other non-empty sparse components can be inspected in the viewer above.

A plain-wall transition around 32 seconds has weak feature overlap. Windows, mirrors, clear chairs, and occluded surfaces remain difficult. A completed pipeline is not proof of a complete or metrically accurate room.
